about_the_game:
Unleash the Kraken Within. Rule the Deep.

In Octopus Invasion, you play as a ravenous octopus with one goal—devour, evolve, and dominate the ocean. What begins as a tiny tentacled creature quickly spirals into a full-blown undersea invasion as you feast your way up the food chain. Explore vibrant underwater worlds, unlock devastating upgrades, and become the apex predator of the deep.

This isn't just a game—it's a feeding frenzy.

🐙 Evolve or Be Eaten

Start small and grow huge by consuming everything in your path. Every fish you eat gives you experience and resources that unlock new mutations—from extra tentacles and increased speed to special abilities like ink bombs or stingray minions.

🌊 Conquer the Ocean

Explore six unique biomes—from colorful coral reefs to dark abyssal trenches. Each zone introduces new challenges, prey, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered. Complete quests, unlock secret zones, and find rare creatures lurking in the depths.

🔧 Upgrade & Customize

Shape your octopus to fit your playstyle:

  • Upgrade swim speed, attack power, and tentacle count

  • Deploy autonomous stingray minions for passive resource gathering

  • Customize your evolution path—speed demon, brute force, or survivalist?

🧠 Smart Prey, Dynamic Ecosystem

Not everything goes down easy. Prey may flee, fight back, or outsmart you. Use tactics and power-ups to outmaneuver and overpower tougher enemies—including schools of fish and predatory sharks.

🎮 Play Your Way

  • Supports both Landscape and Portrait play

  • Compatible with Mouse, Keyboard, or Controller

  • Optimized for Steam Deck with easy-to-pick-up controls

Key Features:

  • 🎣 30+ sea creatures to hunt and consume

  • 🧬 Endless upgrades and evolutionary paths

  • 🌍 Open underwater world exploration

  • 🐠 Stunning stylized 3D visuals and fluid animation

  • 🗝️ Quest system with keys to unlock new content

  • 🧩 Casual core, deep progression

  • 🎮 Relaxing, family-friendly gameplay with survival elements

Are you ready to rise from the reef and dominate the deep?
Download Octopus Invasion and start your underwater reign today.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur (11.0) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 6100 or Apple integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Monterey (12.0) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1/M2 chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics (AMD Radeon Pro 560 or equivalent Apple Silicon GPU)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse recommended
